problem.statement: The Intent Document is committed into the same PR as the code it describes, so its own file (.intent/<branch>.json) shows up in the PR diff — and the coverage check counted it as an unexplained change, forcing a document to account for itself.

evolution.formulation: Generate a real Intent Document for a review-assist change and open a PR.
The .intent file itself appears as an uncovered hunk — a document shouldn't have to explain its own file.

user_asks: "raise a pr for this repo and check what the generation looks like"
"generate the required intent document for the change"
out_of_scope: The v2 items (cross-repo linking, rich markdown/mermaid content, safe rendering) are recorded in SPEC but not implemented in this change.

assumptions.assumption: `.intent/` is the only path used for Review Assist's own bookkeeping inside a target repo.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: If documents were ever stored elsewhere, that path would still be miscounted against coverage.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Confirm submit_document only ever writes under .intent/ (see packages/mcp-server).

open_questions.question: Should staleness ignore doc-only commits, so committing the document (which advances HEAD past the recorded head_sha) doesn't read as stale?
open_questions.context: The document records the code head; committing it as a second commit moves HEAD. The viewer doesn't enforce staleness, but the Action would.

requirements.text: A document must not have to explain its own file
Validator and viewer must agree on coverage, so CI and the UI never disagree

trials.what: Anchor the .intent file with an incidental tour stop so it counts as covered
trials.outcome: Works, but is self-referential and pushes the mechanism into every document
trials.why_abandoned: Excluding .intent/ from the denominator is cleaner and needs no per-document effort

adopted.summary: Exclude .intent/ paths from the coverage denominator in both the validator and the viewer, cover it with a test, and record the v2 roadmap in SPEC.
adopted.rationale: Keeps the every-change-explained guarantee for real code without forcing the document to account for itself; applying it in both the validator and the viewer keeps CI and the UI consistent (req 2).

tour.title: Validator: skip .intent/ in coverage
tour.what: runCoverage() now continues past any diff file under .intent/, via a new isIntentPath() helper.
tour.why: This is the authoritative check CI runs, so excluding the document's own file here is what actually lets the PR pass (req 1).
tour.attention: The helper matches both the exact path `.intent` and the `.intent/` prefix — check it can't accidentally match a real source dir like `.intentional/`.

tour.title: Viewer: the same exclusion, client-side
tour.what: computeCoverage() skips .intent/ files so the rendered coverage badge matches the validator.
tour.why: CI and the UI must agree (req 2); otherwise a PR could pass CI yet show an uncovered change in the viewer.

tour.title: Test the exclusion
tour.what: Adds a validator test: a diff that includes a .intent/ file still reports full coverage.
tour.why: Locks the behavior so a future refactor can't silently reintroduce self-counting.

tour.title: Record the v2 roadmap
tour.what: SPEC gains a v2 section: cross-repo linking, rich markdown/mermaid content, safe rendering, and this coverage exclusion.
tour.why: Captures the decisions taken this session so they are not relitigated; the exclusion is noted there as shipped in this change.

performed.description: vitest suite including the new .intent exclusion test

added_tests.covers: .intent/ files are excluded from the coverage denominator

not_verified: The live viewer reflects the exclusion only after a redeploy (done separately from this commit).
Staleness when the doc-only commit advances HEAD past the recorded head_sha — raised as Q1, not addressed here.
